Body.description: Message content (variant based on message type)

Filtered Message.description: Profanity-filtered version of the message (if applicable)

Sender's XUID.description: Xbox User ID of the message sender

Message Category.description: Message category byte carried on the wire ahead of the message type; derived from the type by vanilla encoders.

operations.why: Both pinned sources omit the message category byte that the 1.26.40 wire carries between Localize and the message-type tag; production implementations read and write it.

evidence.summary: Live 1.26.40 fork writes bool, category byte derived from TextType, type byte, then body; chat traffic proxies through it in production.
Cloudburst's newest Text serializer writes the category byte (writeByte(0) MessageOnly) before the type ordinal.

operations.why: The inserted message category byte is unconditional on the wire.

evidence.summary: The category byte is written for every text type.
